title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: The Point, Dublin | 1998
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at The Point in Dublin, Ireland, on 20 August 1998.

It was the eighth show of the fourth All-Starr Band’s European tour, which lasted for 18 dates in August and September 1998.

It was a thrill to at last have a chance to play in the Republic of Ireland a place I have longed to visit as it is the spiritual home of many of my favourite writers of English – Joyce, Wilde, Myles na gCopaleen (Flann O’Brien), Sean O’Casey, and even the Ginger Man himself – no not Baker, but J.P. Donleavy. It was wonderful to be able to walk over the O’Connel Bridge, past St. Stephen’s Green and on down Grafton Street, the haunts of the great flatulent himself, Bloom. Why I even bought some Jil Sander clothes in Brown Thomas! “His heart was going like mad and yes I said yes I will Yes.” The show at The Point was good.
Jack Bruce
jackbruce.com
